article.story: EASTON, Pa. -- — Shareef Jackson had 20 points in Lafayette’s 80-65 win against Binghamton on Wednesday. Jackson added eight rebounds for the Leopards (2-3). Beckett Currie added 20 points while going 6 of 16 from the floor, including 4 for 12 from 3-point range, and 4 for 5 from the line while they also had four steals. Cooper Kesler went 5 of 11 from the field (3 for 7 from 3-point range) to finish with 15 points. Jeremiah Quigley finished with 17 points and two steals for the Bearcats (3-3). Binghamton also got 12 points and two steals from Jake Blackburn. Bobby Montgomery Jr. finished with 10 points and four assists. Lafayette took the lead for good with 9:04 left in the first half. The score was 38-28 at halftime, with Currie racking up 10 points. Lafayette pulled away with a 13-2 run in the second half to extend a six-point lead to 17 points. They outscored Binghamton by five points in the final half, as Jackson led the way with a team-high 14 second-half points. Up next Both teams play again on Saturday. Lafayette visits Syracuse and Binghamton hosts Army. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
